missions.title: Reach the Marker
missions.flavour: I’ve marked a spot up the street.
missions.instructions: The car accelerates on its own. Let it carry you straight north to the marker.

bonus.flavour: One more stop on this street.
bonus.instructions: Drive straight to the next marker.

missions.title: Same Goal, New Street
missions.flavour: Try the same move one street over.
missions.instructions: Keep straight north. The marker is up ahead.

bonus.flavour: One more stop on this street.
bonus.instructions: Drive straight to the next marker.

missions.title: Down the Block
missions.flavour: The next marker is farther down the block.
missions.instructions: Keep going straight north to the marker.

bonus.flavour: One more stop on this street.
bonus.instructions: Drive straight to the next marker.

missions.title: First Bend
missions.flavour: The garage is just around the bend.
missions.instructions: Brake before the bend, then steer right and drive to the garage marker.

bonus.flavour: One more stop on this street.
bonus.instructions: Drive straight to the next marker.

missions.title: Left Turn
missions.flavour: This street takes you to the other end of the garage block.
missions.instructions: Brake before the bend, then steer left and drive to the garage marker.

bonus.flavour: One more stop on this street.
bonus.instructions: Drive straight to the next marker.

missions.title: Right Turn
missions.flavour: The next garage is around the right bend.
missions.instructions: Brake before the bend, then steer right and drive to the garage marker.

bonus.flavour: One more stop on this street.
bonus.instructions: Drive straight to the next marker.

missions.title: Two Streets
missions.flavour: Both sides of the block lead to the garage.
missions.instructions: At the T-junction, turn left or right. Follow that side of the block to the north garage.

bonus.flavour: One more stop on this street.
bonus.instructions: Drive straight to the next marker.

missions.title: Other Approach
missions.flavour: You’re on the other side of the same garage.
missions.instructions: Drive straight to the east garage from the south.

bonus.flavour: One more stop on this street.
bonus.instructions: Drive straight to the next marker.

missions.title: First Pickup
missions.flavour: There’s a package before the bend.
missions.instructions: Collect the marked package, then turn left and reach the west safehouse.

bonus.flavour: There’s another stop around the corner.
bonus.instructions: Head north, turn right at the bend, and reach the marker.

missions.title: Straight Pickup
missions.flavour: The package and safehouse are on the same street.
missions.instructions: Drive straight through the package marker, then continue to the west safehouse.

bonus.flavour: There’s another stop around the corner.
bonus.instructions: Head north, turn right at the bend, and reach the marker.

missions.title: Pickup After Left
missions.flavour: The package is just past the left bend.
missions.instructions: Turn left, collect the marked package, and keep straight to the west safehouse.

bonus.flavour: There’s another stop around the corner.
bonus.instructions: Head north, turn right at the bend, and reach the marker.

missions.title: Pickup After Right
missions.flavour: This time the package is past the right bend.
missions.instructions: Turn right, collect the marked package, and keep straight to the west safehouse.

bonus.flavour: There’s another stop on the south street.
bonus.instructions: Head south, turn left at the bend, and reach the marker.

missions.title: Second Safehouse
missions.flavour: Same pickup, different drop-off.
missions.instructions: Collect the package on the west street, then turn left at the south bend and reach the south safehouse.

bonus.flavour: There’s another stop around the corner.
bonus.instructions: Head west, turn right at the bend, and reach the marker.

missions.title: First Pursuit
missions.flavour: A patrol is already behind you.
missions.instructions: Turn left at the bend and reach the north garage before the patrol catches you.

bonus.flavour: There’s another package on the north street.
bonus.instructions: Collect the package, then turn right and deliver it to the east garage.

missions.title: Second Garage
missions.flavour: Take the car back to the east garage.
missions.instructions: Turn right at the bend and reach the east garage before the patrol catches you.

bonus.flavour: There’s a package on your way to the next garage.
bonus.instructions: Collect the package on the east street, then turn left and reach the north garage.

missions.title: Two Ways Out
missions.flavour: You know both ways around this block.
missions.instructions: At the T-junction take either side of the block and reach the north garage before the patrol catches you.

bonus.flavour: There’s one more package on this block.
bonus.instructions: Pick up the package on the north street, then turn left toward the west safehouse.

missions.title: Different Start
missions.flavour: The garage is just ahead from here.
missions.instructions: Drive straight to the north garage before the patrol catches you.

bonus.flavour: There’s one more package on this block.
bonus.instructions: Pick up the package on the north street, then turn left toward the west safehouse.

missions.title: Delivery Revisited
missions.flavour: You’ve turned this corner before.
missions.instructions: Turn right at the bend and reach the north garage before the patrol catches you.

bonus.flavour: There’s one more package on this block.
bonus.instructions: Pick up the package on the north street, then turn left toward the west safehouse.

missions.title: Quiet Delivery
missions.flavour: The east garage is open again.
missions.instructions: Follow the south street, then turn left toward the east garage.

bonus.flavour: One package, then the south safehouse.
bonus.instructions: Collect the package on the east street, then turn right and reach the south safehouse.

missions.title: Familiar Pickup
missions.flavour: The package is back before the bend.
missions.instructions: Collect the package on the north street, then turn left to reach the west safehouse.

bonus.flavour: There’s another package just up the street.
bonus.instructions: Collect the package, then keep straight to the marker.

missions.title: Pickup Under Pursuit
missions.flavour: A patrol is following you on the pickup route.
missions.instructions: Collect the package, then turn left and reach the west safehouse before the patrol catches you.

bonus.flavour: There’s another package just up the street.
bonus.instructions: Collect the package, then keep straight to the marker.
